notes.title: [Sex Counselor] Release commemorative review event!
notes.notes:
Sex Counselor' release commemorative event!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41454859/d024abe033f0eedcd600e22284804c0977941422.png
Hello.
Momentum Games. 

Thank you for your love and interest in the release of "Sex Counselor." 
We were worried about how to express our gratitude to so many people, so we organized a small event to reward their support.

Please leave a review to tell us what you thought about playing "Sex Counselor" or what improvements you've made.

We will listen to everyone's opinions and strive to make the game even better.

We will select 10 people who give us important reviews and give them a $5 Steam gift card.
(Automatically changes to each country's currency based on the exchange rate selected by VALVE)
With your interest and encouragement, we will continue to grow as Momentum Games.

You can quickly receive information on new products and events through the Momentum Homepage, so please follow us often.
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44912591

thank you.

- Event name: "Leave a review to support the release of Sex Counselor"
- Event product: 10 people selected. $5 steam gift card
- Event period: June 13th to July 12th, 2024
- Event announcement: July 19th

notes.title: SecretPie End Roll' Update News!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868127/5512746bc1a8803f4ff0fd1977e8f79a1c3d297c.png
Hello.
Momentum Games.

I would like to share some happy news with you today.
Finally, the first update news for the long-awaited Secret Pie - DLC3 (End Roll).

""Shiori's H scene"", one of the heroines of DLC3, has been updated.
The anime has further emphasized Shiori's charm and sexiness, so please come and watch it!

[Place with photo]

Furthermore, we are holding a ``20% release discount event'' only until the ``Illustrations and H-scene anime line'' is completed. 
Buy with a little more discount and enjoy amazing creations updated weekly!

See you next week with more attractive H scenes.

thank you.


Secret Pie link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1802870/Secret_Pie/
End roll link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2889150/Secret_Pie__End_Roll/
